nodes.label: $FLUTTER_BASE_HREF placeholder
nodes.rationale: Replaced by --base-href at flutter build so the app can be served from a non-root path.

nodes.label: generateCanonicalUrl()
nodes.rationale: Canonical URLs prevent duplicate content issues.

nodes.label: packages/db Shared Drizzle Schema (per GEMINI.md)
nodes.rationale: GEMINI.md claims packages/db/src/schema.ts is the single source of truth; CLAUDE.md says schema lives in apps/api/src/database — likely outdated.

nodes.label: @repo/db tsconfig Path Alias
nodes.rationale: Re-exports apps/api/src/database/db-client.ts; a tsconfig alias, not a real workspace package.

nodes.label: Route head() Meta Tags Pattern
nodes.rationale: SSR head tags mean no client-side JS is required for SEO.

nodes.label: Semantic CSS Variable Tokens
nodes.rationale: Changing one variable updates every component referencing it.

nodes.label: Component Customization Order (variants, className, cva variant, wrapper)
nodes.norm_label: component customization order (variants, classname, cva variant, wrapper)

nodes.label: Dark Mode via .dark class and next-themes
nodes.norm_label: dark mode via .dark class and next-themes

nodes.label: No Manual dark: Overrides
nodes.rationale: Semantic tokens handle light/dark via CSS variables.

nodes.label: Use Semantic Colors
nodes.rationale: Semantic tokens like bg-primary adapt to themes/dark mode; raw values like bg-blue-500 do not.

nodes.label: Dry-Run / --diff / --view Mode
nodes.rationale: Always preview via CLI instead of fetching raw files from GitHub; CLI handles registry resolution, paths, CSS diffing.

nodes.label: Switching Presets
nodes.rationale: Merge path (init --force --no-reinstall + smart merge) preserves user customizations vs overwrite.

nodes.label: Updating Components (Smart Merge Workflow)
nodes.rationale: Preserves local component customizations when pulling upstream changes.

nodes.label: Never Decode Preset Codes Manually
nodes.rationale: Use preset decode/url/open/resolve and apply/init --preset instead of hand-building preset URLs.

nodes.label: No Sizing Classes on Icons in Components
nodes.norm_label: no sizing classes on icons in components

nodes.label: Avatar Needs AvatarFallback
nodes.rationale: Handles image load failure.

nodes.label: Dialog/Sheet/Drawer Title Required
nodes.rationale: Required for accessibility; use sr-only if visually hidden.

nodes.label: Select API Differences (items prop, placeholder, positioning)
nodes.norm_label: select api differences (items prop, placeholder, positioning)

nodes.label: Compose, Don't Reinvent
nodes.rationale: Pages are compositions of primitives (Settings = Tabs+Card+form controls; Dashboard = Sidebar+Card+Chart+Table).

nodes.label: Adding Custom Colors (Tailwind v3/v4)
nodes.rationale: Add to the tailwindCssFile from info; never create a new CSS file.

nodes.label: No Raw Colors for Status Indicators
nodes.norm_label: no raw colors for status indicators
nodes.rationale: Use Badge variants or semantic tokens like text-destructive.

nodes.label: Use Existing Components First
nodes.rationale: Search registries (incl. community) before writing custom UI to avoid reinventing components.

nodes.label: Opaque Session-Token Authentication
nodes.rationale: AuthGuard looks up bearer token in tokens table on every request instead of verifying signed JWT; @nestjs/jwt used only for one-off signed tokens like password reset links.

nodes.label: REST-primary API with Code-first GraphQL Layer
nodes.norm_label: rest-primary api with code-first graphql layer
nodes.rationale: One controller per module for REST; newer modules like stats use GraphQL resolvers with schema auto-generated to src/schema.gql (never hand-edit).
